name: jira_issue_transition
description: Performs a workflow transition on an issue; the transition must be valid from the issue's current status per the workflow's transitions table (POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions)

issue_key.description: The ID or key of the issue to transition, for example RECON-101.

transition_id.description: The ID of the transition to perform, for example 21. Use jira_transitions_list to find the transitions valid from the issue's current status.

comment.description: An optional comment to add to the issue when the transition is performed.
